timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: That dream shook me and I’m still feeling it.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My heart is racing like it was real.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me isn’t sure I’m safe yet.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice how tense my whole body feels.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind keeps replaying pieces of the dream.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel shaken, even though I’m awake now.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Falling back asleep feels scary right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that dream really scared me.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This fear is lingering, even though the dream is over.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can remind myself that I’m safe right now.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: That was a dream, and I’m here in my own bed.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to carry that fear into this moment.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel my body starting to settle.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind can let that dream fade now.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel shaken and still be okay.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can breathe slowly until my heart catches up.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to change position or open my eyes if it helps.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This room is quiet, and I’m safe in it.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of calming myself back down.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that I’m safe here, right now.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to fall back asleep peacefully.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let my body feel heavy and calm again.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind can rest now that I’m grounded.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning that I can settle myself after moments like this.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can trust the quiet of this room.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel safe enough to close my eyes again.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to drift back into easy, restful sleep.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Let this steadiness carry you back into sleep.
